g.title: system-architecture
g.text: Non-custodial Stellar account closure · the API builds transactions · the browser verifies and signs

g.title: cluster_browser
g.text: Verification, signing, and orchestration happen here

g.title: cluster_backend
g.text: No user keys · no custody · one mediator co-sign key · API-key auth

g.title: ui
g.text: Plan preview · per-step confirmations · irreversibility warnings

g.title: proxy
g.text: Injects the API key · per-IP rate limit · short-TTL cache
The browser never holds an API key

g.title: wallet
g.text: Freighter · Albedo · LOBSTR · Hana · WalletConnect · more

g.title: signer
g.text: User inspects every operation before signing

g.title: sk
g.text: Wiped on completion, abort, or navigation away

g.title: verify
g.text: Checks the API-built XDR against the user's own choices
Asserts intent before signing · a mismatch aborts · never trusts the API's word

g.title: sess
g.text: IndexedDB · no keys · no signed envelopes
Resumable after browser close · reconciles on-chain on re-entry

g.title: analysis
g.text: Full pre-flight merge check per §3 result codes

g.title: close
g.text: Builds the minimal unsigned transaction set
Deterministic plan · re-reads live state · re-derives remaining work each round

g.title: med_be
g.text: Validates exact shape · cannot change destination or amount

g.title: defi
g.text: OctoPos proxy · freshness gate · degraded mode

g.title: cache
g.text: Public read data only · no identity · no user keys

g.title: idx
g.text: Enumerate trustlines · offers · data · signers · pool shares
Set by configuration; swapping providers needs no code change

g.title: octopos
g.text: Detects positions across all Soroban DeFi protocols

g.title: route
g.text: Quote routes · compute min-received for slippage protection

g.title: soro_api
g.text: Optimal swap routes · LP pair data
Builds Soroban swap XDR (client verifies before signing)

g.title: reg
g.text: Exchange deposit addresses -> memo type rules
Contract wasmHash -> protocol version (Blend V1/V2 · pool IDs)

g.title: ledger
g.text: Source of truth for all account state
